Corollary
[Angular pressure-gradient bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0126 ↗ prop:chow-iv-backward-pressure-cylinder 1. ch29:29.37\group Backward Pressure Limit

For every nonround solution there is $C<\infty $ such that \[ \left|\frac{\partial }{\partial \theta }\log v\right|\le C \qquad \text{on }S^2\times (-\infty ,-1]. \]
